title: 'A La Ba' verse: my dear cousin and your kitchen
summary: De De gives and explains a verse about eating well and drinking wine for free at a cousin's kitchen, and says he sometimes makes up verses as he sings.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
